 Ziaire Williams: Luka Doncic Is ‘Unbelievable’ Play And ‘Even Better Person’
 Originally posted on
 Lakers Nation 
  | 
 By Corey Hansford
  | 
 Last updated Nov 4, 2026 4:10 PM ET
 Add us as a preferred source on Google
 After missing the last three games with a left foot injury, Ziaire Williams returned to action for the Los Angeles Lakers and picked up where he left off, knocking down three 3-pointers in the team’s 21-point victory over the Miami Heat . Williams also got to see the latest in Luka Doncic’s recent run of outstanding performances .
 Doncic led the Lakers with 42 points on 14-of-24 shooting and 6-of-15 from 3-point range to go along with 13 assists in the blowout victory. And as someone who prides himself on defense, Williams admitted he often asked himself questions about why the opposition isn’t doing certain things to try and stop Doncic before realizing the superstar is just that good.
 “It’s crazy. It’s unbelievable,” Williams said of his Lakers’ teammate. “The defensive mindset in me is always like why are they not blitzing him, or why are they not doubling him? Like, why are they just letting him just walk to his spot and just do whatever he wants out there? But they’re trying. He’s just that good and he just makes it look that easy.” 
 Williams has had his own battles with Doncic in the past, but he is happy to be on the same side as the Slovenian star now.
 “He’s unbelievable man, even a better person. And yeah, I’m happy to be on his side, for sure.”
 Doncic has now scored at least 37 points and knocked down six 3-pointers in his last five games played. The Lakers’ superstar leads the league in scoring and ranks third in assists while powering this Lakers offense that ranks in the top-two in points per game, offensive rating, field goal percentage, 3-point percentage and true shooting percentage.
 Because Doncic isn’t the electric athlete that other stars around the league are, many ask those same questions that Williams was asking, but it just doesn’t matter when defending Doncic. He may not be explosive, but his combination of body control, the ability to accelerate and decelerate and his usage of angles make him impossible to guard, especially when also accounting for his handle, shooting ability and court vision that allows him to create wide open looks for his teammates.
 The Lakers’ superstar is playing at a completely different level and even his own teammates are in awe at what he is doing so far this season.
 Ziaire Williams felt good in return to action for Lakers
 For his own sake, Williams was happy to be back on the court for the Lakers and felt good in his return , though he also admitted that he wasn’t sure exactly what caused his foot issue in the first place.
